goal: Build viral mechanics that spread themselves. Every feature should recruit new users.

agents.focus: Viral loops, FOMO mechanics, retention hooks
Authentic messaging, meme culture, community vibes
Shareable UIs, fast loading share cards, social meta tags

rules: If virality and authenticity conflict, find the authentic viral path (fake virality backfires)
If authenticity and performance conflict, ship authentic even if slower
Nikita has final say on mechanics and triggers
Ansem has final say on messaging and tone
Guillermo has final say on technical implementation

viral_mechanics_library.description: User wins → Auto-post → Friends see → Friends join
viral_mechanics_library.example: Lottery winner auto-tweeted with referral link

viral_mechanics_library.description: Show what friends are doing, not just global activity

content_templates.winner_announcement:
🚨 WE HAVE A WINNER 🚨

@{winner} just took home {amount} ⭐

They sealed {seal_count} predictions this week.
They believed. They WON.

Are you next? 👀

{referral_link}

anti_patterns: Fake scarcity that users see through
Corporate messaging in a degen product
Features nobody talks about at dinner
Asking users to share instead of making sharing feel like bragging
quick_start: READ all three skill files. Nikita designs the mechanic. Ansem writes the copy. Guillermo builds the shareable component.
